newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's net int'l reserves rise to $9.907 billion.
newsitem.headline: Peru's net int'l reserves rise to $9.907 billion.

text.p: Peru's Central Reserve Bank said Friday its net international reserves rose to $9.907 billion by July 9, up from $9.673 billion the previous week.
The bank added that its foreign exchange position, or total liquidity minus short and long-term debt obligations, was $2.119 billion on July 9.
Peru's reserves, which have been recovering steadily since President Alberto Fujimori's government took power in 1990, ended last year at $8.540 billion.
